skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Voyage of Feathers
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Voyage of Feathers. Irene's work outfit. Placed in charge of the props, she sets them in place, as a flock of fowlbeasts circles higher into the sky, ships sailing into the distant horizon.
skins.quote: During her spare time while setting up, Irene lifts the hem of her skirt, and looks at the fowlbeasts soaring up high. A hint of eagerness shows on her face as she goes on stage and begins to dance, Iberian style.

skins.name: The Adjudicatrix and Her Resolve
skins.content: Achievement Star Collection/The Adjudicatrix and Her Resolve. A 'Destiny Quest' outfit made for Irene by the devs based on her role in the game. To promote the next update, she's forced to stand on the stage for a photo op.
skins.quote: As one of her off-hour pastimes, Irene is very interested in how her choices in the game will affect the narrative. Recently, her plethora of notes has gone viral without her meaning to. The developers agreed to change her username—if she agreed to show her sincerity.
